raw_data.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways.

The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth.

About the Role

We are hiring an International Marketing Lead, SMB Ads, reporting to the Head of SMB Ads Marketing, to build and scale OpenAI’s SMB Ads business outside the United States. You will own SMB business targets across international markets and lead the team and cross-functional plans that deliver advertiser acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue growth.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role at the intersection of product marketing, growth marketing, demand generation, lifecycle marketing, partnerships, and sales enablement. You will directly manage the international SMB Ads marketing team and lead its work within a global matrix: set country priorities and resource choices, translate global strategy and capabilities into regional and local execution, and bring local insight back to shape global plans.

In this role, you will:

  • Own international advertiser and revenue targets. Translate them into country plans spanning acquisition, activation, retention, expansion, and advocacy.

  • Prioritize countries based on market potential, product readiness, channel economics, and regulatory and operational requirements. Balance global consistency with local relevance.

  • Launch locally relevant go-to-market programs with regional marketing, sales, and partnership leaders across positioning, demand generation, lifecycle, education, offers, and conversion.

  • Improve the international advertiser experience with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations, from signup and campaign creation to payments, measurement, support, and trust.

  • Align regional sales leaders around shared growth goals, market plans, enablement, and coordinated customer engagement.

  • Direct investment across markets and programs. Align budgets, team capacity, agency resources, and global capabilities with growth opportunities, and refine allocation as results emerge.

  • Lead international performance reviews, forecasting, and growth initiatives with Sales, Product, and Finance. Use experimentation, funnel insights, and return on investment to improve results.

  • Hire, coach, and develop the international SMB Ads marketing team. Establish clear goals and a culture of experimentation, collaboration, and accountability.

  • Connect regional and local insights to global strategy. Establish planning and review rhythms that shape marketing, product, and operational roadmaps.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring significant experience owning international business or growth targets, with measurable customer and revenue results in SMB, self-serve, advertising, SaaS, marketplace, commerce, or fintech businesses.

  • Demonstrate success hiring and developing marketing teams, scaling across countries, and leading collaboration among global, regional, and local teams.

  • Balance global strategy with local customer needs, prioritizing investment across markets, segments, and programs.

  • Understand how to acquire, activate, educate, and retain SMB customers at scale.

OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways.

The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth.

About the Role

We are hiring an International Marketing Lead, SMB Ads, reporting to the Head of SMB Ads Marketing, to build and scale OpenAI’s SMB Ads business outside the United States. You will own SMB business targets across international markets and lead the team and cross-functional plans that deliver advertiser acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue growth.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role at the intersection of product marketing, growth marketing, demand generation, lifecycle marketing, partnerships, and sales enablement. You will directly manage the international SMB Ads marketing team and lead its work within a global matrix: set country priorities and resource choices, translate global strategy and capabilities into regional and local execution, and bring local insight back to shape global plans.

In this role, you will:

 - Own international advertiser and revenue targets. Translate them into country plans spanning acquisition, activation, retention, expansion, and advocacy.

 - Prioritize countries based on market potential, product readiness, channel economics, and regulatory and operational requirements. Balance global consistency with local relevance.

 - Launch locally relevant go-to-market programs with regional marketing, sales, and partnership leaders across positioning, demand generation, lifecycle, education, offers, and conversion.

 - Improve the international advertiser experience with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations, from signup and campaign creation to payments, measurement, support, and trust.

 - Align regional sales leaders around shared growth goals, market plans, enablement, and coordinated customer engagement.

 - Direct investment across markets and programs. Align budgets, team capacity, agency resources, and global capabilities with growth opportunities, and refine allocation as results emerge.

 - Lead international performance reviews, forecasting, and growth initiatives with Sales, Product, and Finance. Use experimentation, funnel insights, and return on investment to improve results.

 - Hire, coach, and develop the international SMB Ads marketing team. Establish clear goals and a culture of experimentation, collaboration, and accountability.

 - Connect regional and local insights to global strategy. Establish planning and review rhythms that shape marketing, product, and operational roadmaps.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Bring significant experience owning international business or growth targets, with measurable customer and revenue results in SMB, self-serve, advertising, SaaS, marketplace, commerce, or fintech businesses.

 - Demonstrate success hiring and developing marketing teams, scaling across countries, and leading collaboration among global, regional, and local teams.

 - Balance global strategy with local customer needs, prioritizing investment across markets, segments, and programs.

 - Understand how to acquire, activate, educate, and retain SMB customers at scale.

 - Use funnel data, market research, customer insight, and experiments to make clear decisions in evolving markets.

 - Build trusted partnerships with regional sales and marketing leaders, global specialist teams, Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Legal, and Operations.

 - Combine growth, lifecycle, content, partner, and field programs into effective market plans.

 - Bring familiarity with advertiser acquisition, campaign setup, and education on platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok for Business, Amazon Ads, Reddit, or Snap.

 - Translate strategy into execution, launching programs, evaluating results, and scaling successful approaches.

raw_data.title: Lead, Revenue Accounting, Technical
raw_data.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI Finance helps ensure the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

Within Finance, the Technical Revenue team partners with Product, Legal, GTM, Strategic Finance, Revenue Accounting, Finance Systems, and the company’s GTM Deal Desk organization to enable scalable, audit-ready monetization. We advise on commercial and contract design, establish defensible accounting positions under ASC 606, and provide clear conclusions and handoffs for downstream execution by Revenue Accounting Operations.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Technical Revenue Enablement to lead Revenue Recognition deal advisory for OpenAI’s general B2B commercial activity.

Reporting to the Head of Technical Revenue, you will serve as the primary Revenue Recognition counterpart to OpenAI’s Deal Desk organization, partnering with Legal, GTM, Product, Pricing, and Strategic Finance throughout the presignature deal lifecycle. You will own intake and triage, advise on non-standard terms, approve arrangements supported by established policy and precedent, and route novel or strategic matters to the appropriate technical owner.

You will build a scalable deal-advisory model by translating ASC 606 into practical contract guardrails, approved language, decision trees, review thresholds, and clear service levels.

This role requires deep technical accounting judgment, commercial fluency, strong stakeholder influence, and the ability to make timely, risk-based decisions in a fast-moving environment.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the Revenue Recognition deal-advisory function for general B2B transactions, serving as the primary finance counterpart to OpenAI’s GTM Deal Desk organization.

  • Partner early with GTM Deal Desk, Legal, GTM, Product, and Strategic Finance to evaluate proposed economics and terms before commitments are made or contracts are signed.

  • Own deal intake and triage, distinguish standard, non-standard, novel, and strategic arrangements, and route matters to the appropriate technical owner based on policy, materiality, and risk.

  • Review and resolve revenue recognition issues involving performance obligations, variable consideration, commitments, credits, concessions, contract modifications, options, incentives, implied promises, acceptance provisions, and consideration payable to a customer.

  • Approve transactions covered by established policy and precedent, and develop clear, recommendation-led escalation packages for novel or material judgments.

  • Translate technical conclusions into practical commercial guardrails, approved contract language, fallback positions, decision trees, and training for GTM Deal Desk, Legal, and GTM.

  • Partner with contract-review operations to establish review service levels, prioritization standards, stakeholder communications, performance metrics, and feedback loops that support deal velocity without compromising revenue integrity.

  • Prepare audit-ready conclusions and standardized accounting handoffs for Revenue Accounting Operations, including performance obligations, transaction price, allocation, revenue pattern, monitoring requirements, and billing-versus-revenue differences.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of technical revenue accounting, revenue recognition, or related advisory experience, with deep ASC 606 expertise and experience leading complex workstreams.

  • Significant experience partnering with commercial Deal Desk, Legal, Sales or GTM teams on high-volume B2B contracts and non-standard commercial terms.

  • Strong command of performance-obligation analysis, variable consideration, consideration payable to a customer, contract modifications, material rights, principal-versus-agent analysis, and gross-versus-net presentation.

  • A track record of translating technical accounting requirements into practical contract language, commercial guardrails, and workable alternatives.

  • Strong risk-based judgment and the ability to distinguish routine matters, precedent-supported exceptions, novel policy questions, and strategic transactions.

  • Experience building or improving deal intake, triage, approval, escalation, service-level, and governance processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to balance deal velocity with accounting integrity, audit readiness, and clear decision rights.

  • Strong commercial judgment and executive communication skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting issues and practical trade-offs to senior non-accounting stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated success influencing cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority in ambiguous, rapidly changing environments.

  • CPA strongly preferred; a mix of Big 4 (or accounting advisory) and technology industry experience in high-growth environments is highly valued.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. raw_data.title: Internal Communications, Research and Product
raw_data.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity. Our Internal Communications team helps employees stay informed, connected, and engaged so they can focus on building and deploying safe and impactful AI. We partner across the company to explain what’s being built, why it matters, and how it connects to our strategy and mission.

About the Role

We’re looking for an internal communications professional to help employees understand the work happening across OpenAI’s research and product organizations. You’ll translate technical developments, product milestones, and team priorities into clear, useful communications that connect people to the work and to one another.

Reporting to the Internal Communications lead for Research and Product, you’ll be the second member of the team dedicated to this part of OpenAI. You’ll independently own specific communications programs and projects within the broader strategy, build trusted relationships with technical teams, and identify stories and information employees need to hear. You’ll also help build practical processes that allow a small team to support a broad and fast-moving organization.

This role requires strong writing and editing skills, technical curiosity, and sound judgment. You should enjoy asking questions, making sense of complex information, and moving work forward independently, with guidance from your manager on broader strategy and sensitive issues.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Own recurring communications programs that help employees understand research and product priorities, progress, and upcoming milestones.

  • Lead communications for defined projects and initiatives, developing plans, gathering input, drafting content, coordinating reviews, and managing delivery.

  • Translate complex technical and research concepts into accurate, accessible stories for employees with different levels of technical knowledge.

  • Build trusted relationships with researchers, product managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to stay close to their work, identify important developments, and surface communication needs.

  • Write and edit content across internal channels, including leadership and org updates, Slack posts, FAQs, explainers, and All Hands materials.

  • Develop demos, research deep dives, and Q&A sessions that help employees hear directly from technical teams, including shaping content and preparing speakers.

  • Maintain and improve communications workflows, including editorial planning, templates, review processes, and shared resources that keep information timely and easy to find.

  • Use employee questions and feedback to improve communications, identifying gaps in understanding and recommending follow-up content or changes to format and cadence.

  • Partner with your manager on major announcements and organizational changes, owning defined workstreams and flagging sensitive issues, dependencies, and decisions that need leadership input.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in internal communications, product communications, journalism, or a related field, ideally with exposure to research or technical teams.

  • Bring strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with an emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and making information useful to the audience.

  • Have independently managed communications projects from planning through delivery, coordinating stakeholders and balancing competing deadlines.

  • Are curious about AI, research, and product development, and comfortable asking questions until you understand a topic well enough to explain it.

  • Build strong working relationships and can gather input, offer editorial guidance, and keep projects moving with busy partners.

  • Exercise sound judgment with sensitive information and ambiguity, and know when to make a decision independently or seek guidance.

  • Enjoy creating practical, repeatable processes that improve the quality and consistency of communications.

  • Respond well to feedback and adapt as priorities change.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

jobs.title: 🔥 Manager, Revenue Accounting, Technical (Strategic Commercial Deals)

raw_data.title: Manager, Revenue Accounting, Technical (Strategic Commercial Deals)
raw_data.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI Finance helps ensure the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

Within Finance, the Revenue Accounting, Technical team partners with Product, Strategic Partnerships, Business Development, Growth, Legal, Deal Desk, GTM, Strategic Finance, Revenue Accounting, and Finance Systems to enable scalable, operationally sound monetization. We advise on commercial and contract design, establish clear accounting positions under ASC 606, and translate those conclusions into repeatable processes, systems, controls, and reporting.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Manager of Revenue Accounting, Technical to drive the end-to-end technical revenue and operational workstream for OpenAI’s strategic commercial deals—from early structuring and deal-desk review through contracting, launch, and ongoing governance.

Reporting to the Head of Revenue Accounting, Technical, you will serve as a key revenue advisor for complex and non-standard strategic deals, translating commercial objectives into revenue models that are economically sound, accounting-compliant, and operationally executable. You will partner with senior team members on the most novel or high-risk matters across strategic collaborations, cloud marketplaces, platform and distribution deals, licensing and revenue-share models, joint go-to-market initiatives, research collaborations, and other emerging commercial structures.

You will engage from the earliest stages of a deal to shape economics, pricing, commercial terms, contract language, and product design; define the supporting data, billing, settlement, reporting, systems, controls, and revenue-recognition model; and drive cross-functional readiness through launch. After launch, you will help govern amendments, monitor whether the model is operating as intended, resolve execution issues, and evolve the approach as the partnership or business model changes.

This role requires strong technical accounting judgment, commercial fluency, clear cross-functional communication, and the ability to independently drive complex workstreams while knowing when to seek input or escalate.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the day-to-day technical revenue workstream for a portfolio of strategic commercial deals from initial concept and term-sheet development through contracting, launch readiness, post-launch changes, and ongoing governance.

  • Build and pressure-test revenue models for strategic collaborations, cloud marketplaces, platform and distribution deals, licensing and revenue-share arrangements, and other emerging commercial models, including pricing, minimum commitments, incentives, credits, variable consideration, usage mechanics, and settlement flows.

  • Partner through the deal-desk process with Strategic Partnerships, Product, GTM, Strategic Finance, Legal, GTM Deal Desk, Tax, Finance Systems, and Revenue Operations to shape deal economics, pricing, contract terms, product configuration, and operational design from initial proposal through approval and launch.

  • Assist senior team members in evaluating complex transactions under ASC 606, including principal-versus-agent considerations, gross-versus-net presentation, performance obligations, variable consideration, contract combinations, commitments, credits, incentives, and related-party considerations, escalating precedent-setting judgments for senior review.

  • Translate technical conclusions into required commercial and contract terms, practical deal-desk guidance, approval guardrails, and clear intake, escalation, and decision-making processes for material deals, amendments, and renewals.

  • Design revenue models end to end by defining the contracting, product, data, order-to-cash, usage, billing, invoicing, settlement, reconciliation, reporting, systems, and control requirements needed to operate them; partner with operational teams to build, test, document, and scale the resulting processes.

About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. OpenAI for Government (OAI4G) helps public-sector institutions understand, adopt, and deploy highly capable AI products in support of their missions. The team brings together Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, Technical Success, Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, and other cross-functional partners to help governments use AI responsibly and effectively.

As part of OAI4G’s International Public Sector team, you will help public institutions in the UK, Middle East (ME) and Latin America (LATAM) translate frontier AI into secure, compliant, mission-aligned outcomes. We work across varied procurement, regulatory, security, sovereignty, and commercial environments, while maintaining a consistent commitment to safety, reliability, and public benefit.

About the role

We are seeking a Global Account Director (GAD) to lead OpenAI’s public-sector work across the UK, ME and LATAM. You will build trusted relationships with government leaders, develop and execute account strategies, create and close complex opportunities, and help customers move from initial interest to successful adoption.

This is a full-cycle, highly cross-functional sales role that combines technical understanding, strategic vision, partnership management, and value-driven execution. You will work with senior government, operational, technical, procurement, policy, and security stakeholders to identify high-impact AI use cases and translate them into credible commercial and deployment pathways across the OpenAI Platform API and Codex and ChatGPT Enterprise.

You will also be an accountable customer leader after signature, working alongside specialist delivery and technical teams to keep customer outcomes, milestones, adoption, risks, and executive alignment on track. The role requires excellent judgement, executive presence, local fluency, and the ability to move between strategy, discovery, capture, procurement, delivery governance, and relationship management without day-to-day direction.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will

  • Own a focused portfolio of UK, ME and LATAM public-sector accounts.

  • Build and execute comprehensive account plans that map mission priorities, stakeholders, procurement paths, partners, use cases, risks, and long-term expansion opportunities.

  • Drive complex opportunities through the full sales cycle, from pipeline generation, discovery, qualification, capture, and commercial strategy through negotiation, closure, adoption, and expansion.

  • Lead public-sector customers through their AI adoption journey, helping them identify responsible, high-impact use cases and connect mission outcomes to OpenAI’s capabilities and limitations.

  • Translate between government leaders, end users, technical teams, policy and security stakeholders, and internal product and engineering partners, clearly communicating requirements, progress, risks, and dependencies.

  • Serve as the accountable customer lead for engagements tied to clear outcomes, customer milestones, adoption measures, and commercial commitments, coordinating closely with technical specialists.

  • Work closely with the Partnerships team, global and regional system integrators, cloud and technology providers, local delivery partners, resellers, and strategic international partners to shape joint pursuits, deployment models, and purchasing paths.

  • Develop capture strategies, competitive positioning, win themes, teaming decisions, and proposal narratives that reflect UK, ME and LATAM market conditions.

  • Navigate public-sector procurement, tendering, security, data-residency, compliance, and sovereignty requirements, bringing Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, Finance, and other partners into opportunities early.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior government executives and decision-makers, while staying close to operational users and technical stakeholders whose workflows determine successful adoption.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, account records, customer follow-up, and executive reporting, with disciplined follow-through across markets and time zones.

  • Monitor the government, technology, procurement, partner, and competitive landscape across UK, ME and LATAM markets, surfacing insights that inform product roadmaps and go-to-market strategy.

  • Represent OpenAI at government, partner, and industry forums, strengthening networks and identifying opportunities that advance responsible public-sector adoption of AI.


We’re seeking someone with experience including

  • 10+ years in government, diplomacy, national security, international development, multilateral institutions, public-sector technology sales, business development, consulting, transformation, systems integration, or a closely related field, with meaningful ownership of complex customer outcomes.

  • Direct experience in government, diplomacy, national security, foreign affairs, or international organisations, or very significant experience working with those customers in sensitive, regulated, or high-consequence environments.

  • Material experience operating credibly in sensitive or national-security-adjacent settings; an active or recently held government security clearance is valuable, and the ability to obtain or maintain any clearance required for the portfolio may be necessary.

  • A strong record of shaping and closing complex cross-border deals: account planning, discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, capture, proposal development, negotiations, forecasting, closure, adoption, and expansion.

  • Executive presence with senior diplomats, ministers, multilateral executives, government leaders, and decision-makers, alongside credibility with technical, operational, procurement, policy, and security stakeholders.

  • Sound understanding of multilateral and public-sector procurement, funding, contracting, security, privacy, data-residency, sovereignty, and compliance requirements across more than one ME or LATAM market.

  • Ability to orchestrate regional and international partners, including system integrators, resellers, cloud providers, development institutions, advisory partners, and delivery partners.

  • Enough AI and enterprise-technology fluency to explain OpenAI’s products, capabilities, limitations, and responsible-use trade-offs clearly to diplomatic, multilateral, and government audiences, and to engage the right specialists early.

  • High ownership, exceptional written and verbal communication, diplomatic judgement under ambiguity, strong capacity management across regions and time zones, and willingness to travel across ME and LATAM, and internationally as needed.

Nice to have

  • Deep relationships across international organisations, regional bodies, development institutions, foreign affairs, defence, national security, or other sensitive public-sector communities.

  • Experience developing opportunities across more than one ME or LATAM market, ideally with exposure to international organisations or regional bodies.

  • Experience with AI/ML, cloud, data platforms, cybersecurity, API-based products, public-sector digital transformation, or regulated cross-border technology deployments.

  • Experience moving a complex cross-border opportunity from early mission discovery through procurement, deployment governance, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
